The '''Tho Yor Arrival''' at [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] marked the zero year for the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Standard Time]] dating system using '''TYA''' notation. 0 TYA took place in the year [[36,453 BBY]], 32,800 years before the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], 35,453 years before the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] and 36,418 years before the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

Following the initial settlement that took place in 36,453 BBY, a [[Second migration|secondary migration]] occurred over a millennium later.<ref name="SWDotJ1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dating notation using ''TYA'' was first revealed by the ''Star Wars Books'' Facebook page however it was not until Amazon.com previews of ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'' were released that it was revealed the acronym "TYA" represented "[[Tho Yor]] Arrival". ''Into the Void'' mistakenly placed the TYA date at 36,463 BBY.
